subject: re-dif
title: RE.DEF.  ---- C.CONT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 295 (CMOA(II)-53). RE-DIF (redefinitions) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. The title names RE-DEF (redefinition); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: TRS (transition), POL-DY (political dynamics) and MT-IMP (multi-implications). From TRS: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From POL-DY: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From MT-IMP: MT-DI (multi-dimensional). From SOC-RT-DY: PROG-SIGN (progressional significance). From MT-DI: DY-F (dynamic functionalism) and INFO-DY (information dynamics). From INFO-DY: RE-ST (restructuralism).
